sql: SELECT fct_posting.title, fct_posting.url FROM fct_posting JOIN dim_company ON fct_posting.company_key = dim_company.company_key WHERE dim_company.company_name = 'Reddit' AND fct_posting.family = 'ai_engineer' AND fct_posting.is_open = true AND fct_posting.remote_us = true AND fct_posting.is_canonical_listing = true
reason: The query joins the postings and company tables to filter for Reddit's open, remote-US, canonical AI engineer listings.
